value.name: Marcus agrees to reduced rate
value.description: After struggling to speak, Marcus agrees to do half the Bridgepoint rate, not the closer place, starting the first of the month if Asha handles the paperwork.
evidence: Marcus's swallow turned, on the third try, into a sentence: he could do half of the Bridgepoint rate, not the closer place, and he could do it starting the first of the month if she handled the paperwork.
value.time_hint: starting the first of the month

value.name: Asha accepts Marcus's offer
value.description: Asha immediately agrees to Marcus's terms and repeats her assent so he understands she means both the paperwork and his showing up.
evidence: Asha said yes before she let herself feel it, and then said it again so he would hear that she meant the paperwork and the showing up both.

value.name: Asha realizes urgency after call ends
value.description: When the call ends, Asha stays with her father's hand and realizes the difficult part of the arrangement is only beginning.
evidence: When the call ended she kept her hand on her father's, the rate sheet still creased under her thumb, and understood that the easy part had just finished.

value.name: Asha learns Bridgepoint transfer requirements
value.description: Asha recognizes that Bridgepoint needs a signed transfer packet, a physician's order, and a wired deposit before Friday at five, with the bed available only until the weekend.
evidence: Bridgepoint needed a signed transfer packet, a physician's order, and a deposit wired before Friday at five, and the admissions coordinator there had already left one message about a bed that would not hold past the weekend.

value.name: Asha texts Marcus her contact details
value.description: Asha sends Marcus a message promising to handle everything and asking him to send his email, while watching for confirmation that the message delivered.
evidence: With her thumb she thumbed out a message to Marcus on the phone in her lap—I'll handle everything, just send me your email—and watched the screen until the delivered tag appeared, because she did not yet trust that he would still be reachable in an hour.

value.name: Asha summons nursing supervisor
value.description: Asha calls the floor nurse and asks for the shift supervisor to come down.
evidence: Then she pressed the call button on the rail and asked the floor nurse to send the shift supervisor down

value.name: Asha demands discharge paperwork
value.description: When the prepared shift supervisor arrives, Asha requests the attending's discharge order and medication reconciliation, states the family has chosen Bridgepoint, and insists on waiting for confirmation herself.
evidence: when the supervisor came in with the careful, prepared face Asha already knew from a hundred case meetings, she said she needed the attending's discharge order and a medication reconciliation started today, that the family had chosen Bridgepoint, and that she would wait there for confirmation rather than have it routed through the social worker wh
